registered_tldr: TLDR: First qualify native Jev on complete synthetic maps, then compare early report order with social/private decisions and retained/reset state against pooled and deterministic baselines. Measure whole-map error bounds, missing responses and paired history disagreement. Exploratory fixed-evidence pilot; no adaptive scouting or changed-weight claim.
run_tldr: Q0-A1 tests native Jev on six complete synthetic maps with three private reset observers each, against exact terrain labels; measures validity and whole-map and land/water error bounds. This is competence qualification, not evidence of a history or exploration effect.
